result.summary: The page layout is largely intact, but the 'Popular right now' featured card for Tokumaru Ramen Bar renders a broken/missing image placeholder instead of a restaurant photo, which is the most visually broken element. A couple of minor polish issues accompany it.

issues.description: The large hero image area of the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in 'Popular right now' shows a gray box with a broken-image glyph instead of an actual photo, making the flagship card look broken while all other cards display imagery.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image URL/asset loading and provide a proper fallback (branded gradient, cuisine illustration, or logo) plus a retry/lazy-load mechanism so an empty broken-image icon is never shown.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button on the placeholder card is a mid-gray circle on a light gray background, giving it very low contrast and making it look disabled compared with the dark translucent heart buttons on the photo cards.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent button treatment (e.g., white or dark translucent circle with sufficient contrast) regardless of whether the underlying image loaded.

issues.description: The '€0 delivery' badge is duplicated: once as an overlay pill on the card image and again in the metadata line ('25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen'), adding visual redundancy.
issues.suggestion: Show the free-delivery highlight in only one place, preferably the badge overlay, and drop it from the metadata row.
